title: 2 Lincoln Green Dr Markham Open House Video Tour
description:
Well situated within the Bullock neighbourhood of Markham, welcome to 2 Lincoln Green Drive, a multi-level side split home with front and side yards landscaped with perennial gardens and shaded by mature trees.

The charming covered front entry opens into a ceramic tiled foyer with mirrored door coat closet, and a triple sided gas fireplace adds a warming touch here, and in a ground level family room with hardwood floors, and which is brightened with natural light through east- and south-facing bay windows.

Off the foyer, a set of stairs leads up to a main level living room with a box beam ceiling and built-in display shelves. Its hardwood floors are continued into the adjacent dining room, which combines elegant ceiling trim with a modern chandelier. A wall pass-thru maintains an openness to the kitchen, and entertaining is easily extended outdoors through a walk-out onto a large concrete patio in the side yard.

A home chef’s delight, the spacious kitchen features updated flooring; crisp white cabinetry with molded uppers and a pantry; fridge, stove, and built-in dishwasher; ceramic-tiled back splashes; as well as a servery area with a breakfast bar counter extension. Large windows in these rooms allow for plenty of natural light, and the living rooms’s bow window has shades for additional privacy. 

Another set of steps leads to the upper level, which features a hallway linen closet, and a 3-pc main washroom with pedestal sink, walk-in shower, California shutters, as well as built-in linen and toiletry storage. Hardwood floors are found in the hallway and in the three bedrooms - spacious, light-filled rooms, and all which have ceiling fans for fresh air circulation. 

From the foyer is access to a bonus ground level room suitable as a home office, bedroom, or sitting area - and this level also features a back door entry to a walkway giving access to both side yards, as well as a powder room and another entry into the family room.

The lower level offers additional living and storage space, and features a large recreation area with parquet flooring, a soft neutral colour palette, as well as pot lights to complement the natural lighting.

Outdoor features of the property include gated entries into, as well as patio areas, in both the north and south side yards; cedar hedging, privacy fencing, and a garden shed; and the home itself has a brick exterior and driveway parking for up to four vehicles.

Walking distance to James Robinson Public School, Sherwood Shopping Plaza, and a neighbourhood park - this home is also close to Markville Secondary School, Markville Shopping Mall and numerous plazas in the surrounding Hwy7/McCowan Road area, the Centennial Community Centre, as well as the Centennial GO Station; and it’s just a short drive to access Hwys 404 and the 407. 

For more information, contact Gary McGowan, of Keller Williams Realty Centres, Brokerage, at (905) 895-5972.
author: Open House 24
